_agi_canonical.title: ARB Sweep-Resilient Deleveraging
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous strategy synthesis across a discontinuous sweep state, an upside mandate, and post-sweep carry; public constraints determine the policy without concealed labels.
_agi_canonical.derivation: A hedge of 125,000 leaves the mandated 75,000 ARB and falls below the 120,000-ARB sweep trigger. Under the stated formula, stress loss is -3,750 + 148.75 - 10,500 = -14,101.25, or -23.116803% of the $61,000 original margin. Funding is 65.625.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All public formula outputs must match; free-form rationale is not token-graded.
